cohort: The study included 220 patients (110 planned, 110 unplanned) who underwent cesarean delivery.
finding: Unplanned cesarean delivery was associated with significantly higher peritraumatic distress scores and an increased risk for postpartum PTSD compared to planned cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Unplanned cesarean delivery resulted in significantly higher peritraumatic distress and an increased risk for postpartum PTSD compared to planned cesarean delivery.
